meta.subject: Fixed the issue in LSU where the  bit-width for shared memory requests was incorrect

en.summary: Fixes shared-memory request indexing in the LSU so the shared-memory row index uses shared-memory depth bits instead of dcache set bits.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the shared-memory request bit-width in the LSU was wrong.
The patch changes both the ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx field width and the address slice used to populate it.
The modified logic is in the LSU path that decodes shared-memory requests.
evidence: ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx changes from dcache_SetIdxBits to log2Ceil(sharedmem_depth).
The patch adds a dedicated setIdx_shared slice extracted from the shared-memory address bits.
io.to_shared.bits.setIdx is changed to use setIdx_shared, while the dcache path keeps using the old setIdx logic.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Shared memory and data cache often use different address decomposition. The old logic reused the cache set-index width and slice for shared-memory requests, which can truncate or mis-slice the shared-memory row or bank index and make accesses alias onto the wrong shared-memory location.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: shared-memory row or bank index extraction
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A shared-memory access needs a different index width or address slice than the cache set field.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Compute the shared-memory request index from the cache set field width or cache slice instead of the shared-memory depth.
portability_notes: Apply this only where shared memory and cache use different address layouts.
You can inject the bug by narrowing the index field width or by slicing the wrong address bits.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the LSU logic that forms the row or bank index for shared-memory requests.
Replace the dedicated shared-memory index width with the cache set-index width.
Extract the shared-memory index from the cache-oriented address partition instead of the shared-memory row partition.
Leave the cache request decode path unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx width and io.to_shared.bits.setIdx generation in AddrCalculate
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens the shared-memory index field and computes a dedicated setIdx_shared for io.to_shared.bits.setIdx.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx back to the dcache set width and assign io.to_shared.bits.setIdx from the dcache-oriented setIdx path again.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Shared-memory accesses alias onto the wrong rows or banks and return or store incorrect data.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes the actual field width of ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx.
The fix adds a dedicated shared-memory index extraction path instead of reusing dcache setIdx.
Both changes sit in the LSU path that issues requests to shared memory.
notes: This is both an address-decode bug and a bit-width bug.
It is most visible when shared-memory depth and dcache set count differ.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 LSU 的共享内存请求索引生成，使 shared-memory 行索引使用 shared-memory 深度对应的位，而不是 dcache 的 set 位。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确指出 LSU 中 shared-memory request 的位宽错误。
补丁同时修改了 ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx 的字段位宽，以及生成该字段时使用的地址切片。
被修改的逻辑位于 LSU 生成 shared-memory 请求的路径上。
evidence: ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx 从 dcache_SetIdxBits 改为 log2Ceil(sharedmem_depth)。
补丁新增了从 shared-memory 地址位中提取的专用 setIdx_shared。
io.to_shared.bits.setIdx 改为使用 setIdx_shared，而 dcache 路径仍然沿用旧的 setIdx 逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 共享内存和数据缓存的地址分解通常不同。旧逻辑错误复用了 cache 的 set-index 位宽和地址切片来生成 shared-memory 请求索引，这会截断或切错 shared-memory 的行或银行索引，让访问错误别名到其他位置。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 共享内存行或银行索引提取
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某次 shared-memory 访问需要使用与 cache set 字段不同的索引位宽或地址切片。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 不要按 shared-memory 深度生成请求索引，而是沿用 cache set 字段的位宽或地址切片。
portability_notes: 只在 shared memory 与 cache 地址布局不同的设计中注入该故障。
既可以通过缩窄索引位宽来注入，也可以通过切取错误地址位来注入。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 LSU 中负责生成 shared-memory 行或银行索引的逻辑。
把专用的 shared-memory 索引位宽改成 cache set-index 位宽。
按 cache 的地址分区来切 shared-memory 索引，而不是按 shared-memory 行地址分区。
保持 cache 请求解码路径不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AddrCalculate 中 ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx 的位宽以及 io.to_shared.bits.setIdx 的生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复后，shared-memory 索引字段被扩展，并为 io.to_shared.bits.setIdx 单独生成了 setIdx_shared。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx 改回 dcache set 位宽，并让 io.to_shared.bits.setIdx 再次使用面向 dcache 的 setIdx 路径。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: shared-memory 访问会错误别名到其他行或银行，导致 load 或 store 数据错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁确实修改了 ShareMemCoreReq_np.setIdx 的字段位宽。
修复新增了专用的 shared-memory 索引提取路径，而不是继续复用 dcache setIdx。
这两处变化都位于 LSU 发出 shared-memory 请求的路径上。
notes: 这同时是地址解码 bug 和位宽 bug。
当 shared-memory 深度与 dcache set 数明显不同的时候最容易暴露。
